definitions.explanation: The act or moment of waking from sleep. Can describe the quality of how one wakes up.
A figurative awakening — becoming aware of something new, developing a new consciousness or interest.

examples.english: I woke up feeling refreshed this morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目覚|めざ}め⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Flowers began to bloom with the awakening of spring.

examples.english: I had a pleasant awakening to the aroma of coffee.

⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目覚|めざ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧だった。

notes:
USAGE:
The nominal form of the verb {目覚|めざ}める (to wake up, to awaken). In sense 1, often used with adjectives describing how one wakes up: {目覚|めざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (wakes up well), {目覚|めざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (wakes up poorly). In sense 2, the pattern ～⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目覚|めざ}め (awakening to ~) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目覚|めざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to wake up feeling good
- {目覚|めざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to wake up feeling groggy
- ～⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目覚|めざ}め: awakening to ~
- {目覚|めざ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to experience an awakening
